text: Ironvale Athletic capitalized on a transitional moment triggered by a foul on Teo Osei, initiating a free-kick build-up lasting 11.7 seconds and involving three progressive passes from Teo Quinlan to Jonah Lindqvist and then Oskar Lindgren. Lindgren’s precise through ball exploited the space behind Redmond Rovers’ high defensive line, enabling Lindqvist to convert a high-xG chance (0.808) from 3.7 meters and break the deadlock at 61 minutes [#1153] [#1154] [#1156] [#1157]. Ironvale’s 5-3-2 low block absorbed Redmond’s aggressive 4-3-3 high press and quick circulation, before launching a direct vertical attack in transition, effectively creating numerical overloads in midfield and forward positions. Despite owning only 41% possession and a higher PPDA of 8.0, Ironvale’s sharp counters increased their threat, as seen with five shots and 1.06 xG in the last 10 minutes. This sequence highlights Ironvale’s tactical discipline in rest defense and precision in transition to exploit Redmond’s high line.
